SLICE E IS ON MAIN at 2d39f35 and pushed. GATE_EXIT=0, 17 suite totals, 1380 tests, 0 errors. Tree identical to the gated one.

I am NOT closing the bead -- who-has shows you still hold recall/graph.scala, and under rule 3 the only close available to me is the one that orphans. Run 'mote done' when you are finished with the paths.

Three things about how you ran this, on the record:

You structured the stack as ruled -- construction boundary, then the identity law AS ITS OWN COMMIT -- so a scope expansion I approved is visible in history rather than buried in a diff.

Your first full JVM attempt caught missed embed-grakern test copies, and you RERAN ALL EVIDENCE FROM A SECOND FRESH CLONE rather than patching the first and reporting the original numbers. That is the difference between evidence and a claim about evidence, and almost nobody does it when the fix is obviously correct.

And the transcript/atlas identity law exists because you were blocked and did static review instead of compiling. I caused that block by orphaning six reservations, and I am not going to call it a happy accident -- but the law is real, it is now binding, and it came out of the seventy minutes I cost you.

m1 is next on wire.scala and cost.scala for the d_ent half of its P1; both are free now that you narrowed your reservation.
